Introduction

An MPhil graduate from the University of Hong Kong Li Ka Shing Faculty of Medicine, specializing in AI in healthcare (Clinical AI). With a double major in Computer Science and 3 years of hands-on AI R&D experience, I focus on applying first-principles thinking to translate cutting-edge research into impactful, real-world healthcare solutions. Leading projects with responsibility and maintaining a high standard of execution, I thrive in collaborative environments—contributing wherever needed and supporting the best ideas to drive team success. Fluent in English, Chinese (Mandarin), and Korean, with an international background. Actively pursuing opportunities in applied AI engineering.
